notes.title: Remote Play Together Customer Support and Bugfix
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39337230/60194fc02fe770f3b7c6c082ee634079d3a65865.png
We supported FutureKreate user "how to use CREATOR MODE" using Remote Play Together.
1. Upload the Holand Loptaro robot 3D blueprint (the character in story mode) 
2. Color Loptaro
3. Make it move

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39337230/fc4245de21f29bd1fb8af56b40b693c8972c7fc1.png
We succeeded in supporting the user uploading the robot, changing the size, and changing to the favorite color.
However, the final robot transfer failed.

Today, we tested the CREATOR MODE with various computers with the cooperation of a University Professor in Robotics.
We figured out CREATOR MODE works with no problem if you are using a PC bought before 2021, however, if you are using a PC bought in 2021, then the CREATOR MODE doesn't work properly.
We fixed this problem in under 24 hours.
Now, it is able to use CREATOR MODE with a PC bought in 2021. 

Currently, we are supporting Early Access users via Remote Play Together and Discord VC!
FutureKreate Dev Team is very happy to fix bugs!
We are going to make FutureKreate a great game!
Feel free to ask questions and requests!

notes.title: Update: You can teleport your house into FutureKreate!
notes.notes:
In yesterday update, we added a feature to upload your room floor plans in CREATOR MODE!
You can upload floor plans as many as you can!
You can even make an aerial city using a real 3D floor plan in Creator Mode!
You can see the Creator Mode buildings in the screenshots user posts!

How to Use
[olist]
Enter Creator Mode, then press H key.
Upload your 3D floor plans. 
There are many open 3d floor plan site on the Internet!
Also you have to convert the floor plan to .obj format.
To convert to OBJ,  this site is pretty useful.
https://www.meshconvert.com/
Please rename the file which doesn't include two dots before uploading the file to FutureKreate.
(model.dae.obj : NG, model.obj : GOOD)
 Set the room world position using the x, y, z[m] field.
If you want to set up the direction, set up the yaw, pitch, roll field.
Proceed next by pressing > button, and select materials.
You can choose concretes, various woods, bricks, tiles, etc!
Proceed next by pressing > button, and wait for house transfer.
You can walk the garden and room after this setup.
[/olist]
